_note: Per-channel defaults for studio.py. Content keys are top level; everything about how it LOOKS goes under 'style'. Command-line flags still override.
_style: size_div is a DIVISOR of the frame width, so a bigger number means smaller text. case: sentence|upper|lower|none. Depth comes from border + shadow; box draws a solid plate instead and is off. Colours take ffmpeg syntax with alpha, e.g. black@0.75 or 0x1a1a2e@0.6. Anything here can also be overridden per caption in a staged overlays.json.
_fonts: Press Start 2P is fixed-cell at about one em per character, so caption LENGTH decides the rendered size more than size_div does -- keep lines near 30 characters. Run list_fonts.py to see every installed face drawn with your own text. If a path here goes missing the run warns and falls back to DejaVu rather than stopping.
